title: A Probabilistic Framework for Learnable Optimization Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2408.11629v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a statistical-learning framework for optimization algorithms. The framework is based on probability distributions over optimization trajectories induced by a distribution of optimization problems and a learnable optimization algorithm. Within this setting, optimization performance is represented through measurable performance functionals, including stopping times, contraction factors, and trajectory-level properties. The resulting framework provides a statistical perspective on optimization algorithms, allows their performance to be studied at the population level, and naturally accommodates the learning of optimization algorithms from data. Moreover, it enables the application of statistical-learning techniques to optimization, including PAC-Bayesian generalization guarantees for bounded optimization-specific performance measures. translated_title: 可学习优化算法的概率框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2408.11629v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：我们提出了一种用于优化算法的统计学习框架。该框架基于由优化问题分布和可学习优化算法引起的优化轨迹上的概率分布。在此设置下，优化性能通过可测量的性能泛函来表示，包括停止时间、收缩因子和轨迹级属性。由此产生的框架为优化算法提供了统计视角，允许在总体水平上研究其性能，并自然地适应从数据中学习优化算法。此外，它使得统计学习技术能够应用于优化问题，包括针对有界优化特定性能度量的PAC-Bayesian泛化保证。在凸优化、非光滑优化、非凸优化和随机优化问题上的实验表明...
tldr: 本文提出一个基于概率分布的统计学习框架来建模和优化优化算法，支持从数据中学习算法并提供PAC-Bayesian泛化保证，适用于多种优化问题类型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a probabilistic statistical-learning framework for modeling and optimizing optimization algorithms, enabling data-driven algorithm learning with PAC-Bayesian generalization guarantees across various optimization problem types.
